dedupe_keys.name: lanl lstar radiation belt drift shell modeling

description: LANL* uses trained neural networks to approximate radiation-belt drift-shell parameters. Separate networks correspond to alternative magnetic-field models and training samples from the magnetosphere. The resource is documented by Los Alamos National Laboratory. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RingCurrent, Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RadiationBelt; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. An approximation inherits the domain and assumptions of its training field model; quoted speed advantages were not independently benchmarked. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
